answer_2.quote: We report state-checking and transition accuracy using FINEREASON...We also report precision, recall, and F1 scores of the state-checking task.

answer_4.quote: We conduct a human analysis of the mistakes made in state checking, categorising them into error types such as Misinterpretation of Premises, Exploration and Backtracking Issues, Inconsistent Reasoning, etc.
answer_4.guideline: Human annotators examined model outputs and classified errors into predefined categories.
